reviews.body: Thanks for tracking this down across all four providers. LGTM!

Walkthrough

Streaming responses from Gemini, local, OpenAI, and Zai now detect API error payloads in decoded chunks. A shared function converts those payloads to API errors. Each provider emits a terminal error event and stops processing that stream. **Changes: Streaming API error handling** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Shared stream error conversion**
`internal/llm/stream_error.go`, `internal/llm/stream_error_test.go`|`StreamError` handles empty payloads, bare strings, and error objects, then creates an API error. Tests cover empty inputs and error messages.| |**Provider stream handling**
`internal/llm/providers/gemini/*`, `internal/llm/providers/local/*`, `internal/llm/providers/openai/*`, `internal/llm/providers/zai/*`|Each provider captures raw error payloads in stream chunks. When `StreamError` returns an error, the provider emits a terminal error event and stops processing. Tests cover partial content followed by an upstream error.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to e3c7f

Streaming chat from OpenAI, local, Z.AI and Gemini now fails with an API error when the provider sends an error chunk, instead of returning a truncated answer as a success. No actionable merge-blocking risk remains.
